title: Beta Sai Taendehon Ma
chord: B · G · Am · F · C · G · F · B
lyrics:
So tung ditulak rohami panjouon ni Tuhanta i
Disi do hangoluanmi, sadarion ma tangkup i
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
Diboto ho do umurmi ? Hatop do dapot ajalmi
Sadari on mangolu ho, hatop ma ho tu Jesus ro

Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
Ndang sonang ho di tano on, nang gok di ho portibi on
Rade di ho adian i, sadari on ma tangkup i
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion

Pardosa na sumalin ho, dijangkon Jesus do nang ho
Didokkon ho, ihuthon ma, sadari on mangolu ho
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
Sadarion, sadarion, paujung i sadarion
